assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and all three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional rough geometry. Issue #846 also records a possible spatial offset between the provisional overall polygon and mapped park geometry.
assumptions.impact: Locations and area-sensitive metrics are suitable for concept review and intake only; replace the polygons and recalculate the whole chain before professional scoring.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Organizer supplies cleared official GIS or CAD polygons.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, statutory land use and infrastructure capacity are not in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Land-use bands and building envelopes express design logic, not approved controls.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, use, age, condition and ownership are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: The twelve address carriers are conceptual envelopes; no demolition or retention decision is asserted.

assumptions.statement: This AI submission did not conduct a site visit, stakeholder interview, resident workshop or real-user test.
assumptions.impact: Personas and service journeys are design hypotheses derived from the public taskbook. A professional team must verify them with fieldwork and inclusive participation before any pilot.

assumptions.statement: Road sections, traffic counts, station interfaces, water conditions and safety data are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: The address line is a connectivity proposition; detailed linework requires transport and engineering review.

assumptions.statement: Heritage inventory and construction-control zones are not supplied as authoritative polygons.
assumptions.impact: Memory stations and landmarks remain movable, low-impact concepts pending heritage review.

assumptions.statement: No private, biometric or individual trajectory data is used. Public directories and consented aggregate records are the only proposed data inputs.
assumptions.impact: Every scenario has a human review and exit path; service design cannot decide eligibility or enforcement.

assumptions.statement: Steward roles and event cadence are proposed operating arrangements, not confirmed appointments or government commitments.
assumptions.impact: A professional team and local partners must confirm responsibility, budget, safety and accessibility before launch.

assumptions.statement: Figures, icons, diagrams and text are generated for this submission. Microsoft YaHei and Segoe UI are rasterized into page images; font files are not embedded or redistributed. No third-party logo or image is embedded.
assumptions.impact: Any later public campaign must complete separate brand, image and font clearance.
